children: US faith-tech platform's fiscal Q2 revenue grew 188% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA loss for fiscal Q2 narrowed
Company raised fiscal 2026 revenue outlook to $200 mln, expects Q4 Adjusted EBITDA profitability
Gloo expects Q3 2026 revenue of $55 mln and Adjusted EBITDA of negative $3.5 mln
Company raises full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $200 mln
Gloo expects to achieve Adjusted EBITDA profitability in Q4 2026

ENTERPRISE CUSTOMER GROWTH - Co said revenue growth was driven by increased traction with enterprise customers, including more than 30 customers generating over $1 mln in annual contract value and its first customer exceeding $10 mln
CROSS-PLATFORM ENGAGEMENT - Co said more large customers are adopting solutions from multiple Gloo business units and subsidiaries, expanding long-term revenue potential
AI CAPABILITIES - Co said expanded Applied AI offerings and new agentic workflow tools are helping customers improve efficiency and engagement
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Gloo Holdings, Inc. is $12.00, about 277.4% above its September 8 closing price of $3.18
